description: Poll a custom print started by generate_custom_print. status 'done' and 'failed' are final; anything else means still working — poll about every 30 seconds (generation takes 2–10 min) and don't start another generation meanwhile, since an account runs one at a time. When done it returns preview_url (the raw image: embed or attach it so the human sees the print) and design_url (the page to share); then offer add_custom_to_cart with the same print_id. 'failed' carries the reason, and its credits are refunded automatically. Read-only — polling costs nothing.

print_id.description: Generation id returned by generate_custom_print; the same id goes to add_custom_to_cart.

name: get_studio_status

design_url.description: Shareable Studio design page (when done) — the link to SHARE with the human.

preview_url.description: Raw print image (when done) — embed/attach it so the human sees the print in chat.
